model: INMBSPAN001R000 Panasonic AC to Modbus RTU gateway
applies_to: Panasonic / Sanyo ECOi and PACi indoor units (one, or up to 16 controlled together as one) on the R1R2 remote-controller bus, user manual v2.8 (09/2025).
summary: Modbus RTU server that sits on the Panasonic/Sanyo R1R2 remote-controller bus of an ECOi or PACi indoor unit. Holding registers cover on/off, mode, fan, vane, setpoint and limits, room and return temperatures, alarm and error code, filter sign, window-contact logic, outdoor demand limiting and the master/slave pair used for back-up and rotation.

addressing.note: Tables give a 'protocol address' (base 0) and a 'PLC address' (base 1); the protocol address is the wire address and is used for 'documented'.

source.title: Intesis INMBSPAN001R000 Modbus RTU (EIA-485) Interface for Panasonic and Sanyo air conditioners - User Manual
source.pages: pp. 8-12 (registers), pp. 12-13 (temperature notes, outdoor demand), pp. 14-16 (DIP switches), p. 17 (functions)

notes: The manual declares every register a 16-bit unsigned holding register; the temperature ranges listed never go below zero, so temperatures are UINT16. The 'no value' marker the manual writes as -32768 is raw 0x8000 (32768) and is listed as an enum entry.

Temperature registers depend on the DIP SW4 setting: x1 °C, x10 °C (decidegrees) or °F (no °F x10). The register-table footnote calls x10 the default, but the DIP-switch table and the quick-start page (all other switches off) give x1 °C as the factory setting, so scale 1 / °C is used. Check the switch on site: if x10 is set use scale 0.1; if °F is set the values are whole °F.
The manual notes temperatures carry 0.5 °C resolution, which only shows when the x10 setting is used.
Register 5 (temperature reference) is marked R/W in the register table but described as read-only in the temperature section; it is listed as read-only here.

Left out: outdoor demand rate max/min (registers 83/84), because the manual only says they are 'portions of 100%' without a usable scale; machine threshold and custom setpoint-limit registers 1151-1156, because the manual gives their defaults in °C/°F but does not say whether they follow the SW4 x1/x10 setting.
Error code list (Panasonic codes) not reproduced; see manual section 7.

integration.summary: Wire the gateway to R1R2, check SW3/SW4 for address 1 and 9600 baud, power-cycle, then poll holding registers 0-11 with function 03 and write commands one register at a time with function 06.
integration.enable: No enable step; register 7 (gateway disablement) must be 0 for commands to reach the unit. The outdoor demand rate feature is switched on with DIP SW1.
quirks: Temperature scale depends on DIP SW4 and the manual is inconsistent about the factory default.
Function 16 is accepted only with a quantity of one register; functions 3 and 4 both read the same holding registers.
Master/slave registers 4000-4014 only mean something when two indoor units are paired for Panasonic back-up / rotation.
setup: SW3: slave address; SW3/SW4: baud (9600 default).
DIP changes need a power cycle. R1R2 bus max 500 m, not polarity sensitive; EIA-485 max 1,200 m.
Fail-safe biasing must come from the Modbus master.
gotchas: The gateway only answers once it is connected to a powered indoor unit.
The manual warns that a Panasonic wired remote on the same R1R2 bus can make communication drop; avoid more than one remote on the bus.

address_note: address = 0-based Modbus wire (PDU) address; documented = as printed in the source.
note: Re-typed from the manufacturer's public documentation (see source) and verified against it. Registers vary by firmware and options; verify against the live device before writing.
